name: cmuxinator
title: Cmuxinator
description: Focus the cmux window for a cmuxinator project, or start it if it isn't running
author: alpesh

commands.name: open-project
commands.title: Open Cmux Project
commands.subtitle: cmuxinator
commands.description: Focus the cmux window running this cmuxinator project, or start it

commands.name: projects
commands.title: Cmux Projects
commands.subtitle: cmuxinator
commands.description: Browse cmuxinator projects and jump to their cmux windows; a unique name opens directly

preferences.name: cmuxPath
preferences.title: cmux binary
preferences.description: Path to the cmux CLI. Leave empty to auto-detect (/opt/homebrew/bin/cmux, /usr/local/bin/cmux).

preferences.name: cmuxinatorPath
preferences.title: cmuxinator binary
preferences.description: Path to the cmuxinator CLI. Leave empty to auto-detect (~/.cargo/bin/cmuxinator).

preferences.name: socketPassword
preferences.title: cmux socket password
preferences.description: Only needed if cmux Settings > Automation uses password mode with a password that is not in cmux.json. Passed as CMUX_SOCKET_PASSWORD.

preferences.name: autoStart
preferences.title: When not running
preferences.label: Start the project with cmuxinator if no cmux window matches
preferences.description: Uncheck to only focus existing windows.
